name: 黎塞留
nameEn: Armand Jean du Plessis de Richelieu

points.title: 贵族出身
points.description: 黎塞留出生于巴黎的一个贵族家庭，父亲是弗朗索瓦·杜·普莱西，法国国王亨利四世的宫廷大臣。作为家中的幼子，黎塞留原本被安排进入军事生涯，但哥哥的意外去世使他成为家族长子，并被母亲要求进入教会。这一决定改变了黎塞留的人生轨迹，为他日后在政治和宗教领域的发展奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Richelieu was born in Paris to a noble family, with his father being François du Plessis, a courtier to King Henry IV of France. As the youngest son, Richelieu was initially destined for a military career, but his elder brother's unexpected death made him the family heir, and his mother insisted he enter the church. This decision altered Richelieu's life trajectory, laying the foundation for his future development in politics and religion.

points.place: 卢瓦尔河畔的拉罗谢尔
points.title: 主教任职
points.description: 1606年，年仅21岁的黎塞留被任命为卢瓦尔河畔的拉罗谢尔主教。尽管年轻，但黎塞留展现了卓越的行政管理才能。他改革了教区的财政系统，改善了教育条件，并积极参与当地事务。这一时期，他开始接触法国政治圈，并以其才智和手腕赢得了国王亨利四世的赏识，为他日后进入巴黎政坛铺平了道路。
points.descriptionEn: In 1606, at the young age of 21, Richelieu was appointed Bishop of Luçon in La Rochelle. Despite his youth, Richelieu demonstrated exceptional administrative skills. He reformed the diocese's financial system, improved educational conditions, and actively participated in local affairs. During this period, he began to connect with French political circles and gained favor with King Henry IV through his intelligence and political acumen, paving the way for his entry into Parisian politics.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 1614年，黎塞留作为教士代表参加三级会议，首次进入法国政治舞台。他凭借出色的辩论能力和政治智慧迅速崭露头角。1616年，他被任命为国务秘书，1624年，在国王路易十三的信任下，黎塞留被任命为法国首席大臣。这一时期，他开始推行中央集权政策，削弱贵族权力，打击胡格诺派势力，为法国绝对君主制的建立奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1614, Richelieu attended the Estates-General as a representative of the clergy, entering the French political stage for the first time. He quickly distinguished himself through his exceptional debating skills and political wisdom. In 1616, he was appointed Secretary of State, and in 1624, with the trust of King Louis XIII, Richelieu was appointed Chief Minister of France. During this period, he began implementing policies of centralization, weakening noble power, and suppressing Huguenot influence, laying the foundation for the establishment of absolute monarchy in France.

points.title: 权力巩固
points.description: 作为首席大臣，黎塞留面临来自贵族、胡格诺派和宫廷内部的强大反对。1624年，他成功挫败了王后玛丽·德·美第奇的政治阴谋；1628-1629年，他亲自指挥军队围攻并最终占领了胡格诺派据点拉罗谢尔，沉重打击了新教势力；1630年，黎塞留通过著名的'三日政变'彻底击败了王太后和贵族派的联合反对，巩固了自己的权力。这一时期，黎塞留开始系统性地推行国家改革，包括加强中央集权、改革财政和军事系统，为法国成为欧洲强国奠定基础。
points.descriptionEn: As Chief Minister, Richelieu faced strong opposition from nobles, Huguenots, and court factions. In 1624, he successfully thwarted a political conspiracy by Queen Mother Marie de' Medici; from 1628-1629, he personally commanded the army to besiege and eventually capture the Huguenot stronghold of La Rochelle, dealing a heavy blow to Protestant forces; in 1630, through the famous 'Days of the Dupes,' Richelieu completely defeated the united opposition of the Queen Mother and noble factions, consolidating his power. During this period, Richelieu began systematically implementing state reforms, including strengthening centralization, reforming financial and military systems, laying the foundation for France to become a European power.

points.title: 外交成就
points.description: 巩固权力后，黎塞留将注意力转向国际舞台，奉行'国家利益至上'的外交政策。他主导法国参与三十年战争，支持新教国家对抗哈布斯堡王朝，打破天主教势力对欧洲的统治。1635年，黎塞留对西班牙宣战，开启了法西战争。他建立了法国历史上第一个常备外交机构，派遣外交官到欧洲各国，建立了现代外交体系。此外，他还创立了法兰西学术院，推动法国文化发展。1642年，黎塞留去世，他建立的中央集权体系为路易十四的绝对君主制铺平了道路，使法国成为17世纪欧洲最强大的国家之一。
points.descriptionEn: After consolidating his power, Richelieu turned his attention to the international stage, pursuing a foreign policy of 'state interest above all.' He led France's involvement in the Thirty Years' War, supporting Protestant states against the Habsburg dynasty to break Catholic dominance in Europe. In 1635, Richelieu declared war on Spain, initiating the Franco-Spanish War. He established France's first permanent diplomatic service, sending envoys to various European countries and creating a modern diplomatic system. Additionally, he founded the French Academy to promote French cultural development. Richelieu died in 1642, and the centralized system he established paved the way for Louis XIV's absolute monarchy, making France one of the most powerful nations in 17th-century Europe.

supporter.zh: 黎塞留被视为法国现代国家制度的奠基人之一。他通过削弱贵族权力、打击地方割据势力，建立了强大的中央集权国家，为法国成为欧洲强国奠定了基础。他推行的外交政策使法国摆脱了宗教束缚，以国家利益为导向，开创了现代国际关系体系。此外，他创立的法兰西学术院促进了法国文化繁荣，使法语成为国际外交语言。黎塞留的政治智慧和远见使他成为法国历史上最具影响力的政治家之一，其治国理念影响深远。
supporter.en: Richelieu is regarded as one of the founders of the modern French state system. By weakening noble power and suppressing local separatist forces, he established a powerful centralized state, laying the foundation for France to become a European power. His foreign policy freed France from religious constraints and prioritized national interests, pioneering the modern international relations system. Additionally, the French Academy he founded promoted cultural prosperity and made French the language of international diplomacy. Richelieu's political wisdom and vision make him one of the most influential statesmen in French history, with his governance philosophy having far-reaching influence.

critic.zh: 批评者认为黎塞留的统治手段过于残酷，为达目的不择手段。他镇压胡格诺派、打击贵族自由、实施严格的新闻审查，建立了法国历史上第一个秘密警察系统，侵犯了公民自由。他的外交政策虽然使法国成为强国，但也导致了欧洲长期的战争和苦难。此外，黎塞留个人生活奢华，与其宣扬的简朴道德形成鲜明对比，被指责为伪善。他的中央集权政策虽然强化了国家，但也为后来的专制统治铺平了道路，限制了个人自由和地方自治。
critic.en: Critics argue that Richelieu's methods of rule were excessively brutal and that he would stop at nothing to achieve his goals. He suppressed Huguenots, curtailed noble liberties, implemented strict press censorship, and established France's first secret police system, infringing upon civil liberties. Although his foreign policy made France a powerful nation, it also led to prolonged European wars and suffering. Furthermore, Richelieu's luxurious lifestyle stood in stark contrast to the simple morality he preached, earning him accusations of hypocrisy. His centralization policies, while strengthening the state, also paved the way for later authoritarian rule, limiting individual freedoms and local autonomy.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，黎塞留被公认为法国绝对君主制的关键构建者，其治国理念影响了整个欧洲政治发展。他既是宗教改革时期的天主教高级教士，又是推行国家理性政治的世俗政治家，这种双重身份体现了宗教与世俗权力的复杂关系。在流行文化中，黎塞留常被描绘为权谋大师，大仲马的小说《三个火枪手》中的形象深入人心，成为政治操纵和权力游戏的象征。现代历史学者认为，黎塞留的遗产是复杂的：他既建立了现代国家制度，也开启了中央集权的先河；既促进了法国的文化繁荣，也限制了个人自由。他的治国理念至今仍影响着国际关系理论和国家建设思想。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Richelieu is widely recognized as a key architect of French absolute monarchy, whose governance philosophy influenced European political development. He was both a high-ranking Catholic clergyman during the Reformation and a secular politician promoting state rationality, embodying the complex relationship between religious and secular power. In popular culture, Richelieu is often depicted as a master strategist, with his image from Alexandre Dumas' 'The Three Musketeers' deeply ingrained in the public consciousness as a symbol of political manipulation and power games. Modern historians view Richelieu's legacy as complex: he established modern state systems but also pioneered centralization; he promoted French cultural prosperity while limiting individual freedoms. His governance philosophy continues to influence international relations theory and nation-building thought.

self.en: The interest of the state must come first.

others.zh: 黎塞留是法国历史上最伟大的政治家，他不仅改变了法国的命运，也改变了欧洲的命运。
others.en: Richelieu was the greatest statesman in French history; he not only changed the destiny of France but also the destiny of Europe.
